title: Turning Quantum Compiler Configuration Selection Upside Down: A Top-Down Paradigm
abstract: arXiv:2610.29170v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Selecting an effective quantum compiler configuration requires coordinated decisions over both hardware targets and compiler settings, with the ultimate goal of improving circuit execution fidelity. Existing SOTA approaches typically decompose this problem into two sequential stages: a device is chosen first, after which compiler options are tuned on that device through RL-based search. This bottom-up strategy can be fundamentally limited by its initial device decision, since a poorly matched backend may constrain the best fidelity achievable regardless of how effectively later compiler options are optimized. In contrast to classical compiler tuning, where the search space is often prohibitively large, the configuration space of quantum compilers remains manageable enough to support exhaustive search. translated_title: 颠覆量子编译器配置选择：一种自顶向下的范式
translated_abstract: 选择有效的量子编译器配置需要对硬件目标和编译器设置进行协调决策，其最终目标是提高电路执行保真度。现有SOTA方法通常将此问题分解为两个顺序阶段：首先选择一个设备，然后在该设备上通过基于强化学习的搜索来调整编译器选项。这种自底向上的策略可能从根本上受限于其初始设备决策，因为不匹配的后端可能会限制可达到的最佳保真度，无论后续编译器选项优化得多么有效。与经典编译器调优（其搜索空间往往大得令人望而却步）不同，量子编译器的配置空间仍然足够可控，可以支持穷举搜索。因此，与其反复从候选配置中进行搜索，不如从离线（数据中）推导出可复用的配置知识……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种自顶向下的量子编译器配置选择新范式，利用量子编译器配置空间可控、可穷举搜索的特点，颠覆了传统“先选设备再调编译器”的自底向上方法，克服了初始设备决策对电路执行保真度的根本性限制。
